title: Great Product but needs improvement
text:
Great Product but needs improvement. [[VIDEOID:cd417c32aabb9bcf48c791f2f921d005]] Light weight four piece container for all your Ziploc needs, bamboo with metal Hook lock for easy access to open and close. I was able to put a full box for snack bags, the sandwich bags were a little bit overfilled but, didn’t mind that. Really easy to remove anything that you need whenever you need. The size is perfect as it fits into the kitchen drawer pretty neatly and isn’t so wide and deep.
A nice feature that it does have is that it can open fully all the way and it does have holes in the back if you decide that you wanted to drill it into your wall. Other than the fact that it did break during transport, it’s not that much of a big deal. You can just apply wood glue and it should be fine.
